SD53-014.name: Ptolemaios
SD53-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
If you control any Blue "CB" family Spirit, by paying one cost, draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a "Gundam Meister" family Brave card from your Trash by paying one cost.

SD53-008.name: Allelujah Haptism
SD53-008.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 3 Blue "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing originally Cost 5 or less Spirits.

SD53-015.name: Can't be stopped
SD53-015.effect:
[Main]
If you control any "CB" family Spirit, during this turn, increases the costs of every opposing Magic card/[Accel] by +3.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

SD53-012.name: GN Arms Type-E
SD53-012.effect:
When your "Exia"-named Spirit is summoned, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

One and only copy of this card/Brave can be braved to a Spirit that is braved to a "Pilot" family Brave you control, ignoring the amount of Braves on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, refresh a Blue Nexus you control.

SD53-001.name: Gundam Kyrios
SD53-001.effect:
Flash - [Arm Int: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])] (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand at Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Trans-Am] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon an exactly-named "Gundam Kyrios (Trans-Am)" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

SD53-005.name: Gundam Kyrios ［Trans-Am］
SD53-005.effect:
When you're using [Armed Intervention], the symbol of this card in Trash is also treated as being on the Field.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void each to one "CB" family Spirit and one "Mothership" family Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Send this Spirit to your Trash.

SD53-004.name: Gundam Nadleeh
SD53-004.effect:
When your "Virtue"-named Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Refresh three "CB" family Spirits you control.

SD53-002.name: Gundam Virtue
SD53-002.effect:
Flash - [Arm Int: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])] (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand at Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2]
When your "CB" family Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2] [Trans-Am] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon an exactly-named "Gundam Virtue ［Trans-Am］" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

SD53-006.name: Gundam Virtue ［Trans-Am］
SD53-006.effect:
When you're using [Armed Intervention], the symbol of this card in Trash is also treated as being on the Field.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing "Mothership" family Nexus. This effect can't be prevented by [Barrage]. Or, send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus(es) to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Send this Spirit to your Trash.

SD53-003.name: Gundam Dynames
SD53-003.effect:
Flash - [Arm Int: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])] (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand at Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Ignoring the Cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Trans-Am] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon an exactly-named "Gundam Dynames ［Trans-Am］" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

SD53-007.name: Gundam Dynames ［Trans-Am］
SD53-007.effect:
When you're using [Armed Intervention], the symbol of this card in Trash is also treated as being on the Field.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Send this Spirit to your Trash.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4862.name: Gundam Exia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4862.effect:
Flash - [Arm Int: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])] (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand at Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Trans-Am] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon an exactly-named "Gundam Exia ［Trans-Am］" from your Trash, without paying the cost. This effect can also activate at the end of the attack.

[LV2][LV3] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

SD53-X02.name: Gundam Exia ［Trans-Am］
SD53-X02.effect:
When you're using [Armed Intervention], the symbol of this card in Trash is also treated as being on the Field.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Send this Spirit to your Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects of Spirit cards. Also, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

SD53-011.name: Lockon Stratos ［Neil Dylandy］
SD53-011.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 3 Blue "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[During Brave]
Increase the limit of your "Dynames"-named Spirit's "Cost Destruction effect" by +3.

SD53-009.name: Setsuna F. Seiei

This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Blue Cost 3 "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[During Brave]
While this Spirit is LV2 or higher, it gains an extra Blue symbol.

SD53-010.name: Tieria Erde
SD53-010.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Blue Cost 3 "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) While your "CB" family Spirit is attacking, increase the cost of every opposing Magic card/[Accel] by +3.

SD53-016.name: We are Celestial Being
SD53-016.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
During this turn, attacks of opposing non-braved Spirits/Ultimates can't reduce your Life. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total cost of 7.
